caption: The drawing depicts a round, dark brown wooden table with an elaborately carved scalloped edge featuring openwork patterns. The tabletop has a central circular design with what appears to be an illustration or inlay of branches and leaves in a lighter color. The table stands on a single, turned pedestal that branches into three curved legs with scroll-like feet, all showing wood grain and subtle carved detailing. To the right of the table is a smaller, separate illustration in grayscale, showing an overhead view of the table’s underside and pedestal, with details of the joint or hinge mechanism connecting the tabletop to the pedestal. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color, and the artist's name, "Charles Graham," is printed at the bottom.
title: Table
